name: WdLayoutMode
description: Specifies how text is laid out in the layout mode for the current document.

constants.name: wdLayoutModeDefault
constants.description: No grid is used to lay out text.

constants.name: wdLayoutModeGrid
constants.description: Text is laid out on a grid; the user specifies the number of lines and the number of characters per line. As the user types, Microsoft Word doesn't automatically align characters with gridlines.

constants.name: wdLayoutModeLineGrid
constants.description: Text is laid out on a grid; the user specifies the number of lines, but not the number of characters per line.

constants.name: wdLayoutModeGenko
constants.description: Text is laid out on a grid; the user specifies the number of lines and the number of characters per line. As the user types, Microsoft Word automatically aligns characters with gridlines.
